The '''N-115 particle beam disintegrator''' was a type of [[Particle beam/Legends|particle beam]] rifle produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
